title: Smt. Alpna Rolston vs Shri Darwin Rolston on 8 May, 2023

paragraphs.text:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
 
 

?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:AHC:98152
 
Court No. - 1
 

 
Case :- TRANSFER APPLICATION (CIVIL) No. - 776 of 2022
 

 
Applicant :- Smt. Alpna Rolston
 
Opposite Party :- Shri Darwin Rolston
 
Counsel for Applicant :- Diptiman Singh,Abhijit Chatterji
 

 
Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.
1. Heard S/Sri Diptiman Singh and Abhijit Chatterji, learned counsel for the applicant and perused the record.
2. Despite service of notice, no one has put in appearance on behalf of the opposite party.

3. The present application under Section 24 of Code of Civil Procedure has been filed seeking transfer of Case No.2065 of 2022 (Darwin Rolston Vs. Alpana Rolston) filed under Section 10 of the Indian Divorce Act, 1869 from the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Kanpur Nagar to the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Allahabad.

4. The applicant is wife of the opposite party. The applicant has three years girl child born out of the wedlock and lives in Allahabad (Prayagraj) with her parents and due to poor financial condition of her parents, it is very difficult for the applicant to attend the proceedings at Kanpur Nagar.
5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, it would be appropriate to transfer the case as prayed for.

6. Application is accordingly allowed and the proceedings of Case No.2065 of 2022 (Darwin Rolston Vs. Alpana Rolston) filed under Section 10 of the Indian Divorce Act, 1869 is transferred from the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Kanpur Nagar to the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Allahabad.
